verdict.rationale: Claude supports image upload/paste and analysis of visual content (JPEG/PNG/GIF/WebP, PDFs with visuals) and can produce SVG images/diagrams via Artifacts from natural-language descriptions, but there is no evidence of true raster image generation (e.g., photorealistic image synthesis) or editing of existing photos as knowledge-workers would expect from an image-gen feature. Missing for 10: native photorealistic image generation, image editing/inpainting of uploaded photos, independent hands-on confirmation of image-gen quality.
